item.title: Show HN: Airship – Figma-Like Visual Editor for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
item.summary: I wanted to experiment with my UI like I do in Figma, without having to rebuild it in a separate design tool. So I built Airship. It lets you prototype directly in your running app, select elements, make changes, and explore different directions visually. Once you like something, Airship applies the changes to your source. No mockups to keep in sync, or bouncing back and forth between design and code. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49252066 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
